posts.title: Google Chrome dev team declares bug report bankruptcy
posts.description: [ I wrote this in August 2012 and then forgot about it. ] About 18 months ago I filed a report for a bug in Google Chrome. It wasn't a very important bug. I reported that when Chrome was asked to inline an image, and the image turned out to be in the obscure and seldom-used X-bitmap format, it came up as a "broken image" icon (which isn't a bug) and failed to display the alt text from the img tag
